items.exampleEn: Night markets are gaining popularity with tourists from Europe.
items.exampleZh: 夜市越來越受到歐洲遊客的歡迎。

items.exampleEn: He won a prestigious prize for his first film.
items.exampleZh: 他以第一部電影贏得了一個很有聲望的大獎。

items.exampleEn: Banks are financial institutions that keep people's money safe.
items.exampleZh: 銀行是替人們保管金錢的金融機構。

items.exampleEn: In many birds, sexual differences are easy to see, because the males are more colorful.
items.exampleZh: 很多鳥類的性別差異很容易看出來，因為雄鳥的顏色比較鮮豔。

items.exampleEn: After the scandal, many people lost faith in the company.
items.exampleZh: 醜聞爆發後，很多人對那家公司失去了信任。

items.exampleEn: My first week at the new job was hell.
items.exampleZh: 我新工作的第一週簡直是地獄。

items.exampleEn: Many ethnic groups live in this part of the city.
items.exampleZh: 城市的這一區住著許多不同的民族。

items.exampleEn: The minister answered questions from reporters for an hour.
items.exampleZh: 部長回答了記者的問題一個小時。

items.sentenceEn: The popularity of electric scooters has grown quickly in our city.
items.sentenceZh: 電動機車在我們城市越來越普及，成長得很快。

items.audioEn: The minister said that the new train line will open next year.
items.audioZh: 部長說新的鐵路線明年會通車。
options: The minister will retire next year
A new railway will open next year
The old train station will close soon

items.sentenceEn: My parents have always had faith in my decisions.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸媽一直都很相信我的決定。

items.sentenceEn: We went through hell to get tickets for the concert.
items.sentenceZh: 我們吃盡苦頭才買到那場演唱會的票。

items.stemEn: Harvard is one of the most ____ universities in the world, and many students dream of studying there.
items.stemZh: 哈佛是世界上最有聲望的大學之一，很多學生夢想到那裡念書。

items.stemEn: The city museum is one of the oldest cultural ____ in the country.
items.stemZh: 市立博物館是國內最古老的文化機構之一。

items.passageEn: Every autumn, our city holds a food festival that celebrates its many ethnic communities. Its popularity has grown so much that over fifty thousand people came last year. This year, the minister of culture opened the festival with a short speech. She said that a city is like a big kitchen where everyone brings something different. A prestigious cooking school sent its students to cook dishes from around the world, and a local history institution led free walks through the old streets. The festival also got a lot of publicity online. One visitor wrote, "Finding a parking space was hell, but the food was worth it."
items.passageZh: 每年秋天，我們城市都會舉辦一場美食節，慶祝城裡眾多的民族社群。它的人氣成長得很快，去年有超過五萬人參加。今年，文化部長用一段簡短的演說為美食節開幕。她說，城市就像一個大廚房，每個人都帶來不同的東西。一所很有聲望的烹飪學校派學生來煮世界各地的菜，一個地方歷史機構也帶大家免費走訪老街。美食節在網路上也得到很多宣傳。一位遊客寫道：「找停車位簡直是地獄，但食物值得。」

questions.questionZh: 部長在演說中把城市比喻成什麼？
options: 大家各帶不同東西的廚房

questions.questionZh: 地方歷史機構在活動中做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 在很多國家，工作上的性別歧視是違法的。
referenceEn: In many countries, sexual discrimination at work is against the law.
Sexual discrimination at work is illegal in many countries.
rubricZh: 「性別歧視」可寫，例如 sexual discrimination、sex discrimination、gender discrimination 等
「違法的」可寫，例如 against the law、illegal 等
「在很多國家」位置不限（例如放句首、句尾等）

items.instructionZh: 用 faith 造一個句子，說說你對某個人或某件事很有信心。
referenceEn: I have great faith in my best friend's advice.
I have faith that our team will win the next game.
rubricZh: faith 後面可接 in 或 that 子句（例如 have faith in someone、have faith that … 等）
時態配合內容（例如 have、had 等）
